verdict.detail: Same country, catalogue number and year as the first issue (UK, TPSP 351, 1972). Discogs lists 5 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
Rim Text: The Gramophone Co LTD.

This record has ridge on label. No "Made in Gt. Britain" on and title without brackets. 

CBS contract pressing 

On the labels 

Published by: Feldman/Hec Music Ltd. 
℗1972 
Deep Purple 
(Overseas Ltd.) 

On the sleeve 
Catalog# rear sleeve and spine: TPSP 351 
E.M.I Records (The Gramophone Company Ltd.) Hayes • Middlesex • England 
Made and Printed in Great Britain 
Printed and made by Garrod & Lofthouse Ltd
Issued in a laminated gatefold sleeve. 

Recorded live in Japan 
A1: Osaka - 16th August 1972 
A2: Osaka - 16th August 1972 
B1: Osaka - 15th August 1972 
B2: Tokyo - 17th August 1972 
C1: Osaka - 16th August 1972 
C2: Tokyo - 17th August 1972 
D: Osaka - 16th August 1972

Note: There are 2 “THE GRAMOPHONE CO. LTD” label styles, the first one features the album title with brackets, thus: DEEP PURPLE (MADE IN JAPAN). This second version has no brackets and also shows ridges in the label area and is a contract pressing by CBS to meet the high demand for this album at the time. Note also that the ‘MADE IN GT. BRITAIN’ wording is missing from this CBS pressed version.
